responsibility: This header defines the reusable function_base subclasses that model how AArch64 SVE intrinsics behave once resolved to a specific form. It provides the core semantic building blocks for the SVE builtin framework—memory access descriptors, rtx-code and unspec-based operations, reductions, permutes, fixed-insn wrappers, tuple-aware functions, and helper templates like quiet—so that the per-intrinsic implementation files can express expansion, folding, memory properties, and tuple behavior by composing these classes rather than duplicating logic.
